leads.consequence: The PR does not merge automatically into the pinned quattro tip: the base changed style.theme to open the in-shell picker while this branch adds next/prev immediately after the old style.theme action. leads.summary: The bundled theming skill omits the new theme next and prev commands
leads.consequence: An agent using the shipped Theme Commands list sees the newly added bg prev next to bg next but neither omarchy theme next nor omarchy theme prev, despite the PR registering both commands and the menu exposing both. Add the two entries beside theme set/list/current; no CLI registration change is required.
leads.triage: verified by coordinator (theming.md:7-14 at head); published as documentation note

leads.summary: Previous-background lookup confuses distinct hardlinked paths
leads.consequence: For user-managed backgrounds 1-a.png and 2-b.png hardlinked to the same inode plus a distinct 3-c.png, choosing 2-b through the real bg-set leaves a symlink to 2-b; prev instead treats 1-a as the current item due to -ef and jumps to 3-c. This skips the preceding pathname and makes cycling asymmetric with bg-next, which matches the literal symlink path. Compare the symlink's resolved path with each candidate's resolved path, not file identity, while retaining support for relative links and symlinked directories.
leads.triage: dropped: niche pre-existing hardlink edge in bg-prev inode comparison; not material

leads.summary: The icon regression test still accepts nonexistent Yaru names
leads.consequence: A plausible edit to a stock icons.theme (e.g. Yaru-gray-dark) passes the suffix assertion, although Yaru has no gray variant and omarchy-theme-set-gnome sets this invalid theme verbatim. Extend the test to check dark icon values against packaged variants, not only their suffix. This is a test-fidelity issue; the current Vantablack Yaru-dark value does exist.
leads.triage: corroborates Opus residual; published as optional test improvement

leads.summary: Manual's claimed default icon-theme choices omit the newly selected dark variants
leads.consequence: The manual presents a closed list of default icon theme names which contains Yaru-dark but no Yaru-blue-dark, Yaru-olive-dark, etc. The PR selects these names for 15 built-in themes, so users customizing a dark theme are directed only to the old light accent variants. Update the examples or state clearly that the list is non-exhaustive.
leads.triage: dropped: manual outside PR files and already lists Yaru-dark; nitpick

leads.summary: The new theme-next test shadows the setter and misses invalid candidate names
leads.consequence: The new test replaces theme-set with a logger that returns success for every name. All fixture candidates are valid lowercase theme directories. A plausible broken implementation that sends an invalid hidden directory, mixed-case user directory, or broken link to the setter and still notifies (the prior F3 scenario) passes this test. Add a rejecting setter or real headless setter plus an invalid entry, assert that a failed set is not announced and cycling can progress to the next valid candidate. This is test-fidelity corroboration of the existing F3, not an additional runtime defect.
leads.triage: corroborates F3 still_present; test-fidelity detail not published separately

## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

Follow-up to the [earlier review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12247#issuecomment-5835302137) and the [author's reply](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12247#issuecomment-5835450067), checked at `67d6ede7`. The two fixes named in the reply are verified. The theme-cycling note is unchanged. Since the earlier review, the PR has picked up a merge conflict with the current `quattro` tip (`3faafba2`).

| Earlier finding | Status at `67d6ede7` |
|---|---|
| `omarchy-theme-bg-prev` skips video backgrounds | Resolved |
| `vantablack` names an icon theme that is not shipped | Resolved |
| Theme cycling repeats a theme that `omarchy-theme-set` rejects | Still present (code unchanged) |

**Verified:** `omarchy-theme-bg-prev` now uses the same six image and six video extensions as `omarchy-theme-bg-next`. With backgrounds `1-a.png 2-m.mp4 3-z.png 4-w.WEBM` and the real `omarchy-theme-bg-set` (shell and notifications stubbed):

```text
                        previous head (f0f87650)            this head (67d6ede7)
prev x4 from 1-a.png    3-z → 1-a → 3-z → 1-a               4-w.WEBM → 3-z → 2-m.mp4 → 1-a
prev from 2-m.mp4       3-z.png                              1-a.png
theme with only a video "No background was found for theme"  selects the video
```

The new video case in `theme-bg-prev-test.sh` fails against the previous script and passes on this head. `vantablack` now names `Yaru-dark`, which the `yaru-icon-theme` package ships on stable, rc and edge, so all 16 changed icon names now exist in the package. The earlier note on `omarchy-theme-next` and `omarchy-theme-prev` still applies as written: both scripts are byte-identical to the earlier head, and the validation in `omarchy-theme-set` that they do not check is unchanged on the tip.

### Merge conflict with `quattro` after #13403

The earlier review found no conflicts against the `quattro` tip of that time. Since then, #13403 ("Make the theme picker open instantly") has changed the `style.theme` row in `default/omarchy/omarchy-menu.jsonc` to summon the in-shell image picker. The PR inserts its `style.theme-next` and `style.theme-prev` rows directly after the old `style.theme` line, so the hunks now overlap and GitHub reports the PR as conflicting. `bin/omarchy-theme-set` and `test/shell.d/menu-test.sh` merge automatically.

**Impact:** the conflict is textual. Resolving it by taking the PR's side of the hunk silently restores the old `omarchy-theme-switcher` action for Style › Theme, so that row loses #13403's instant-open path. In a trial merge, that resolution passed every test that reads the menu file, with the same pass counts as the correct resolution, and no test asserts that row's action.

**Suggested change:** when rebasing, keep `quattro`'s `style.theme` line and add the two new rows after it. On that resolution, the PR's five new or changed tests, the other menu-reading tests and `omarchy commands --check` pass, and the full suite fails in exactly the same places as the unmodified tip in the same sandbox, so none of those failures comes from this PR. The PR's new assertions pass.

**Documentation:** `default/agents/skills/omarchy/theming.md` gains `omarchy theme bg prev` in its command list, but not the new `omarchy theme next` and `omarchy theme prev`, which the menu and CLI now expose.

**Related open PR:** #12694 (Polam theme) adds a dark theme (`mode = "dark"`) with `icons.theme` set to `Yaru-olive`. If both PRs land, `theme-dark-icons-test.sh` would fail on `polam:Yaru-olive`. Whichever PR lands second would need to switch `polam` to a shipped dark set (for example `Yaru-olive-dark`).

**Optional test improvement:** `theme-dark-icons-test.sh` still checks only the `-dark` suffix. With `vantablack` changed back to the unshipped `Yaru-gray-dark`, it still passes. Checking names against the shipped Yaru set would catch the error that the earlier review found.
